description: Add more candidate dates or times to a WhichDateWorks poll the user organizes, for example when the group asks for another weekend. Pass the poll's manageUrl from create_poll, and `dates` for a poll of all-day dates or `times` for a poll of time slots, all in the future. Options the poll already has are skipped. Everyone who already voted keeps their votes and can vote on the new options.

dates.description: All-day options to add, as YYYY-MM-DD, for a poll of dates. The poll can have up to 100 options in all.

duration.description: Default length of each time slot in minutes. Defaults to 60.

manageUrl.description: The poll's manageUrl from create_poll (https://app.whichdateworks.com/claim/…), or the token at its end. The invite link won't work here.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the times are in. Defaults to the poll's own time zone.

times.description: Time slots to add, for a poll of times. The poll can have up to 100 options in all.

start.description: Start as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, like 2026-12-05T19:00. Without an offset it is wall clock time in `timeZone`.

name: add_options

added.description: The options added; ones the poll already had are skipped.

start.description: Time slot start, in the poll's time zone with its offset.

weekday.description: Day of the week the option falls on, in the poll's time zone, like "Friday". Check it against what the user asked for.

options.description: Every option the poll now has.

start.description: Time slot start, in the poll's time zone with its offset.

weekday.description: Day of the week the option falls on, in the poll's time zone, like "Friday". Check it against what the user asked for.

reopened.description: The poll had closed by itself and reopened for the new options.

title: Add dates or times to a poll
